name: After the grace period the late fee runs from the due date
title: SC-07-10-06 After the grace period the late fee runs from the due date
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site's grace period is 5 days
And unit "A-14" owes 1400.00 due on "2026-10-15"
When the late fee is evaluated on "2026-10-25"
Then the late fee is 23.33
